text: Woori Financial Group has been fully privatised: the Korea Deposit Insurance Corporation's remaining stake was fully cancelled in 2024, and Maeil Business News reports foreign investors have increased their stakes since.
short: Woori Financial Group is fully privatised; KDIC's last stake was cancelled in 2024.

source.name: 매일경제 (Maeil Business News): 정부가 대주주던 우리금융 … 외국인 지분 50% 넘어섰다 [Government-majority Woori Financial: foreign stake now above 50%]
source.quote: 외국인투자자들은 2024년 예금보험공사의 잔여 지분이 완전히 소각된 이후 꾸준히 우리금융 지분을 늘려오고 있다
